scope: Dated public technical evidence for CerviGuard in relation to TealGuard. This record is not a reconstruction of the application state on 19 August 2026.

captureMethod.build: npm run build; production server started with USE_RATIO1_MOCK=true and NEXT_PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_DEMO_MODE=true
captureMethod.fixture: Synthetic mock account and synthetic case record; no patient image or patient data.
captureMethod.procedure: Authenticate to the isolated mock build, open the case-intake and synthetic case-review routes, and save full-page PNG captures at the stated viewport widths.
captureMethod.review: Publisher visual review for synthetic-data labelling, absence of patient imagery and visible non-clinical-use boundaries; files then frozen by SHA-256. No independent attestation is claimed.
captureMethod.captureLimit: The viewport heights used for these full-page captures were not retained. Viewport widths and final output dimensions are recorded below.
